citizen_relevance: Governs all civil discovery in California superior court proceedings. Provides the six tools for compelling testimony (deposition), document production (inspection demands), admission of facts (RFAs), and ESI from parties. PMQ depositions of pension Trust, inspection demands for retirement election records, RFAs to establish undisputed facts about authorization, and ESI requests for database records are all governed by this Act.
